implementation.targetScope: Flat/grouped next, prev and isLast, including empty sections and the unhighlighted wraparound sentinel; actual react-autosuggest 10.1.0 keyboard caller verified. Application adoption is separate.

changes: No copied upstream runtime; zero dependencies.
Counts are validated and snapshotted, so caller mutations cannot invalidate traversal. Invalid cursors are rejected explicitly.
Only occupied section indices are indexed; binary search crosses long empty-section gaps without scanning them on each navigation. Flat lists allocate no section index.
